haikus.haiku:
Apple scent rises
Steam curls, sugar sparks in steam
Warm dough hugs sweet bite
Happy #NationalAppleDumplingDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Paper parchment glows
Ink flows like river song bright
Dreams rise on parchment
Happy #NationalConstitutionDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Soft blue sky sings bright
Starlight drapes the porch with glow
Hank voice rides wind sweet
#HappyBirthdayHankWilliams from @ClamBakeSanta
